Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Read replicas subscribe to a feed of fleet state: stale by seconds is fine for 'cars near me'

Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Ride-specific data (share-my-ride link, live position) never conflicts across rides, so it shards freely

Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Mutations (request, accept, cancel, start, end, tip) go through one logical authority replicated for durability

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Rider requests a ride; the system looks for a driver instead of broadcasting

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Drivers with instant-book get priority and 4 s to say no

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Otherwise offer to the best nearby driver exclusively for ~7 s, then the next, so drivers never race each other

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Confirmed by GPS, driver confirmation or rider code. After this the trip runs and ends with payment and ratings

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: • Objective: keep drivers busy (supply is the scarce side); price is platform-set (surge), not bid by riders

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: • Invariant: a driver can never accept two riders. Mutating requests per city are <1k/s, so one consensus group can own them

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: • Intentionally skipped: database choice, maps/routing (use a third party), regulation, Uber Eats
